findings.title: Stale worker delivers item after lost lease and terminal failure
findings.body: deliverOutbox claims up to10items with30s leases but only heartbeats the current item. Waitingitems can be reclaimed/exhausted while firstdelivery is slow. Oldworker then invokes deliver without validating ownership; completeOutbox silently rejects stale token. Realrepro leaves newlocalreceipt while outboxfailed/receiptnull and casefailed.
findings.impact: Delivery occurs after terminalfailure and operational state remains inconsistent. No financial duplication or duplicate idempotentreceipt demonstrated.
findings.recommendation: Claim work as execution capacity becomes available or maintain queued leases; require validownership before initiating effect. Add slowfirst/revokedsecond batch regression.
